title: Create OpenSpec proposal for timesheet ID numbers
description:
## Context

The invoice generation feature (add-invoice-generation OpenSpec) depends on timesheets having an ID number. Currently timesheets do not have a user-facing ID field.

## Requirements

Create an OpenSpec proposal to add ID numbers to timesheets:
- Timesheets need a sequential ID (e.g., 1234)
- This ID will be used as the invoice number when generating invoices
- One-to-one relationship: each timesheet → one invoice with matching number

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] OpenSpec proposal scaffolded at `openspec/changes/add-timesheet-id/`
- [ ] Design decisions documented (format, generation strategy)
- [ ] Tasks defined for implementation
- [ ] Proposal ready for review

## Blocked By

Nothing - this is a prerequisite for invoice generation.

## Blocks

- Invoice generation implementation (add-invoice-generation OpenSpec)

title: Prevent deletion/regeneration of approved timesheets
description:
## Context

Approved timesheets have an invoice number that ties to a generated invoice. Allowing deletion or force-regeneration of approved timesheets would break invoice integrity.

## Requirements

- Block deletion of approved timesheets (return error explaining why)
- Block force-regenerate (POST with force=true) for approved timesheets
- To delete/regenerate, user must first revoke/delete the associated invoice

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] API returns 400/409 error when attempting to delete approved timesheet
- [ ] API returns 400/409 error when attempting to force-regenerate approved timesheet
- [ ] Error message explains the constraint and suggests revoking invoice first
- [ ] Tests cover both scenarios
